metadata.description: Multi-year harmonized NASA FIRMS active fire monthly records and climatology
metadata.calibration_methodology: Ordinary Least Squares regression on 0.25-deg grid monthly counts (2012-2026). Calibrated count represents MODIS 1-km equivalent fire activity while preserving high-resolution VIIRS sensitivity.

risk_thresholds.Moderate: 10th to 75th percentile of historical monthly baseline
risk_thresholds.High: 75th to 90th percentile of historical monthly baseline
